summary: Iteration 212 - Accounting Export (QuickBooks/Xero) + HK Route Print Round tested. All backend APIs working (100% pass). Frontend Accounting Export panel shows date filters, format selector (QB/Xero), summary tiles (bookings/revenue/payments), and download buttons. HK Route Print button correctly disabled when no rounds. Regression tests pass for nightly-recap-btn, sustainability-btn, group-requests-btn, concierge-inbox-btn.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/accounting/export/{property_id}/summary - Returns {from, to, bookings_count, total_revenue, payments_count, by_source} - VERIFIED (650 bookings, £220,177.43 revenue)
GET /api/accounting/export/{property_id}/sales?format=quickbooks - Returns CSV with DR/CR pairs (Date, Journal No., Account, Debits, Credits, Description, Name, Class) - VERIFIED
GET /api/accounting/export/{property_id}/sales?format=xero - Returns Xero Sales Invoice CSV (*ContactName, *InvoiceNumber, *InvoiceDate, *UnitAmount, *AccountCode, *TaxType) - VERIFIED
GET /api/accounting/export/{property_id}/sales?from_=invalid - Returns 400 'from/to must be YYYY-MM-DD' - VERIFIED
Frontend accounting-export-panel with ae-filters, ae-summary, ae-downloads - VERIFIED
Frontend ae-from, ae-to date inputs - VERIFIED
Frontend ae-download-sales button - VERIFIED (triggers CSV download with toast 'sales CSV downloaded')
HK Route hk-route-print button - VERIFIED (correctly disabled when rounds.length=0)
HK Route panel shows empty state when no cleaning round needed - VERIFIED
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data. aldgate-flats has 650 bookings for accounting export testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 212 adds two competitor gap features: (1) Accounting Export at /api/accounting/export/{property_id}/[summary|sales|payments] - exports bookings and payments as QuickBooks Journal CSV or Xero Sales Invoice CSV. Frontend: accounting-export-btn opens AccountingExportPanel with date filters (ae-from, ae-to), format selector (ae-format), summary tiles (ae-summary), and download cards (ae-download-sales, ae-download-payments). (2) HK Route Print Round button (hk-route-print) - opens printable A4 HTML via window.print(). Button is disabled when rounds.length=0.
